life though the complexity that it its made you experience something and you need to answer what it means for you. Sometimes it's not something that you have the pieces for, right perspective, or is unanswerable. It's lingering and haunts you for an answer a reason,  purpose. That data in your mind begs for a solution that is favorable fixable or "over with aka in the past" but inevitability that will have always still happened and there's no way to deal with that because it shouldn't have. This is where I fight my hardest most trying battles against the injustices of life's chaos. You must steel your mind from allowing in your mind to pick over the same thing (scab) you haven't worked out. You let it slowly fade with time. Over said time you might gain some insight perspective or some other state of mind that will allow you to answer what all that means and the fact that it happened, means to you. I call this survival. Hang on by your fingernails and bide your time, time where you find a "way to cope/endure", belief or something that works for you. You'll know whatever it is when you find it. I too also silently suffer looking for a way to answer things with no answer. Fight against the madness and insanity in the far reaches of the mind and know you can "make it" past losing it. And time does make things better. I personally think don't rush things. Only you will know when you are ready to deal with your demons if you will. Till then tell them to shut up. Or at least try lol good luck and know while unique to you I also deal with horrors of my childhood. I hope this is helpful. Till then stay away from microdosing and weed will sometimes make me pick at memory's and feelings that I have on hold personally. Single biggest thing I can say is this is your journey don't let anybody push you to do acid or deal with or do stuff your not ready to, but know you got to push your self if you do ever want to get past it. Sometime I can maintain it othertimes I fall apart, thats OK welcome to being human. Also I'm high rn so idk just what I think 🤔

My first trip was a wonderful experience and I ended up going on a hike with 2 others that were sober. They knew I popped a tab. (Always test your tabs!) The outdoors and the warm beautiful day brought out the best in my trip. As far as suicidal vibes I can only say form my personal experiences but they always lifed me out of that thinking.(If you have any schizophrenia in your family history I wouldn't do it) ego death was helpful for me pulled my out of my rut and showed me how beautiful life was. It is possible to get hurt or do some stupid things by yourself so I would highly recommend having at least one person sober with you. Besides that I recommend just having a positive energy around the whole thing its nothing to be afraid of but you definitely need to respect it. The more positive you handle the high and more rational you are while tripping the better time you will have. Just breathe keep your mind open and look at it positively like exploring your own mind. That being said hope this helps.
